svg.title: guro_pit site plan
svg.text: guro_pit · the Guro foundation pit (+ guro_pit_rim, guro_pit_street, guro_side_gallery), ch13–17
Site plan in metres, north up (side-gallery inset in a local frame). Guro-dong, Guro-gu, among old factory blocks and new office towers. Fictional site, no real address.
Drawn from the locked ch013 location note (the pit), ch017 (the street) and ch015–ch017 (the side gallery). Inside the gate: the inset on world/otherside_map.png.

INSET · guro_side_gallery (ch15–17), local frame
A low chamber about 6 × 4 m, ceiling 1.8–2.2
m, fractured pale grey stone; lit only by
hard bars of green-dusk light from ceiling
fissures and by headlamps.
a the only way in: a narrow crack in a
rubble wall (choked with rubble in ch17: the
way back is blocked)
b the great pale slab: tilted across Kwak's
shins (his LEFT worse) until ch16's drop;
flat in the middle from ch17, Nib's crushed
handset under its edge
c the steel shoring prop, flung against the
far wall (Minho picks it up, ch17 P13)
d rubble where Kwak half sits propped on his
elbows, dented hard hat (ch15)
e the side-wall fissure the eyeless scuttler
attacks and retreats through (ch16)
10 m (11 px = 1 m, site)
KEY
1 The gate (C): a door-height slit inside a square scaffold-tube frame
on four concrete blocks, near the middle of the north wall; a 10 m ring
of orange safety mesh round it, open on its south side.
2 Ryu Survey's white canopy and table: the base station, the cable drum,
a radio charging rack, two folding chairs. Taeo's chair faces the gate,
8 m from it. The white cable (blue band every metre) enters the frame at
its lower left corner.
3 Dokgo's folding table, 4 m to the right: thermos, tablet, two phones
(the countdown app).
4 The porters' staging area: crates, steel props, cargo straps, and a
jacket rack made of a scaffold tube on two trestles, about 8 m from
Ryu's table and in Taeo's line of sight.
5 Sejin's small white first-aid tent with a plain green cross, far right
near the ramp.
6 Dokgo's battered flatbed truck at the top of the ramp. 7 The white Ryu
van at the ramp's foot.
8 The general contractor's site office on the south-east rim: three
white containers stacked two high, the top one glass-fronted to the pit
(ch13 P01: a clean ledge, a coffee cup).
9 The tall steel hoarding along the street with the sliding mesh site
gate at the top of the ramp, near its west end (ch17).
10 The kerb where Taeo and Nib sit, a few metres east of the gate,
facing south; Nib on Taeo's LEFT (ch17).
11 The idle tower crane, north-west corner.
LOCKS: H-pile and timber-lagging walls; struts and corner braces at
about 4 m and 8 m up (drawn schematically). Eight numbered Dokgo porters
(Dami 07 outside, Kwak 08 missing). The radio works through the intact
cable: grey relay tripods every 50 m inside, supplemental survey
stations 40 m apart (continuity report). Ryu's two line crew and the
mule withdraw at 14:55.
